'''Corellia Space Sector IV-3121''' was an area of space in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] attacked by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in [[sector OC-3101]] fled to sector IV-3121, where it was rescued by a [[Corellian Security Force]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who escorted the freighter to safety.

==Behind the scenes==
This sector is where the third mission for CorSec pilot trainer [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Rhea]] takes place in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''. The name is only mentioned in the mission's title, "Corellia System: Patrol Corellia Space Sector IV-3121".
